about: Static facts for the lab dashboard (DESIGN.md §1.6): hosts, their cards, trees, card firmware and clock policy, known conditions. No personal data, no access paths: ssh targets other than the plain host names go in ~/.config/lab-dashboard/config.json. Card facts from docs/findings/14-card-behaviour.md and AGENT.md §4 (not collectable without opening the card).

aifoundry2.label: aifoundry2
aifoundry2.clock: firmware DVFS 600–800 MHz; above 600 only below about 68 °C, so in practice 600
aifoundry2.note: out of service since 2 Oct: its cooling failed; idle, it heats to 138 °C and drops off the PCIe bus

aifoundry3.label: aifoundry3
aifoundry3.clock: pinned at 600 MHz (NoC 400) by the admin's boot guard (TDP 0 W)
aifoundry3.note: compare switching power over idle, never absolute watts

aifoundry1-c1.label: aifoundry1 card 1
aifoundry1-c1.clock: 600 MHz in every sample: its governor never raises the clock

aifoundry1-c0.label: aifoundry1 card 0
aifoundry1-c0.note: select with ET_DEVICES=0; its fan was replaced on 2 Oct: 49 °C idle, 52–53 °C (peak 56 °C) under 8 minutes of sgemm bursts

known.note: card 0's root port logs about 4,000 corrected PCIe errors an hour; a reseat is pending
